text:
Alex R: Heads up — customer reported ~1.2k missing audit events in their Splunk index for tenant T-842. They line up with a KMS alias rotate window last night. Forwarder logs show manifest uploaded but many shards referenced 404 in S3.
Natalie G: Can you paste the forwarder logs + manifest id? Also which tenant and export config?
Alex R: @NatalieG tenant T-842, export-id export-2026-03-16-16, manifest s3://audit-exports/exports/export-2026-03-16-16/manifest.json
Log snippet:
```
WARN Forwarder: manifest checksum mismatch: expected=abc123, actual=000000
ERROR S3 GET /exports/.../shard-0007.gz 404
INFO Upload worker: wrote shard shard-0012.gz size=0
```
Sam P: 404 on shards usually means multipart write didn't finalize or lifecycle deleted. But checksum mismatch hints at gz corruption or client-side compression step. Any KMS errors in the logs around rotate time?
Alex R: There are a few KMS errors earlier:
`Error: AccessDenied to kms:Decrypt for key alias/rdw-prod-export` at 2026-03-16T16:12:03Z
But the export continued and manifest uploaded with size 0 for some shards.
Maria L: If KMS failed for only some shards, forwarder might have uploaded placeholder zero-byte objects and wrote them in the manifest. That explains the 'orphaned' entries. We need to run replay/backfill. @replay-bot can we get a replay plan for tenant T-842 between 2026-03-16T16:00 and 16:30?
replay-bot: Replay plan created: plan-4567. Steps:
1) Verify KMS alias mapping now points to alias/rdw-prod-export
2) Run exporter backfill: `scripts/replay_backfill --tenant T-842 --from 2026-03-16T16:00Z --to 2026-03-16T16:30Z --plan plan-4567`
3) Monitor `audit-forwarder` logs for `UPLOAD OK` and check Splunk ingestion.
Sam P: Also check Scrubber/Redaction pipeline: missing ancillary fields (tenant_id, request_id) seen in payloads for placeholder objects. Splunk mapping may drop records lacking those fields. We need to patch forwarder to skip placeholder uploads and fail the export instead.
Natalie G: Agree. Short term: do backfill and replay. Long term: add a pre-upload validation and fail manifest commit if any shard size==0 or checksum==000000. I'll open a ticket.
Alex R: Customer ok with replay, asking for ETA. Sam/Natalie can we estimate? Also what's impact on retention/ttl for replayed events (their SIEM retention is 30d).
Sam P: Backfill for 1.2k events should complete < 20min. We'll run with --parallel=8. I'll monitor and update.
Maria L: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with support to confirm Splunk ingestion post-backfill.
